//KeyVault: Source of Foundry:ProjectEndpoint, Foundry:AgentId and ChatToken:SigningKey — the same vault
LabMetricsDashboard reads, which is what keeps the shared signing key identical between the
two apps. Secret names replace ':' with '--' (ChatToken--SigningKey -> ChatToken:SigningKey).
The App Service's system-assigned identity needs the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on it.
Blank the Uri to run entirely on local/App Service settings instead.
//Foundry: ProjectEndpoint and AgentId are SECRETS held in Key Vault as Foundry--ProjectEndpoint and
Foundry--AgentId. Deliberately absent here — this file is tracked in source control.
//ChatToken: SigningKey is a SECRET held in Key Vault as ChatToken--SigningKey, and must be byte-identical
to the value LabMetricsDashboard signs its chat tickets with. A mismatch rejects every
/api/ask call with a 401. Issuer and Audience are not secret and stay here.
